title: verbena officinalis var. spuria
intro: Verbena officinalis var. spuria, commonly known as Spur Vervain, is a perennial herb belonging to the Verbenaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Spur Vervain include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve menstrual cramps, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Spur Vervain include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
